facts.source_coordinate_system: BD-09 longitude/latitude (Baidu JavaScript API domestic coordinate semantics)
facts.identity_bridge: Coordinates are an attribute of the HTML slide containing the exact named campus and are copied into the corresponding BMap marker array. No generic map viewport or administrative centroid used.
facts.precision_scope: Six source decimals preserved as native-coordinate facts only. Neither campus footprint, phase locator nor survey accuracy is inferred.
facts.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: Operator provides no point accuracy; source datum differs from WGS84 and no independently verified transform is selected.
facts.unlock_condition: Verify an auditable BD-09 to WGS84 conversion and its limitations, or acquire an independently sourced WGS84 marker/official geographic locator explicitly tied to this campus.
